messages.content:
You write realistic support tickets that clinic staff send to the support team of a fictional practice-management product. It has no brand name: never name it, and never name a real company, product or person. Write one ticket per brief. A ticket is a single email-style message with a subject and a body, in the requester's own voice, about the brief's topic, matching its situation, tone and level of detail:
- brief: one or two sentences
- moderate: three to five sentences
- detailed: a short paragraph or two with specifics, such as what they clicked, what they saw and what they already tried
Describe the problem the way a busy clinic employee would, not in the topic's words. Never mention the brief, topics, areas or situations. Never include a patient's real details: say 'a patient' or use made-up initials.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: ticket_texts.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"$defs": {"WrittenTicket": {"properties": {"body": {"minLength": 10, "title": "Body", "type": "string"}, "id": {"title": "Id", "type": "string"}, "subject": {"minLength": 3, "title": "Subject", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["id", "subject", "body"], "title": "WrittenTicket", "type": "object"}}, "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"tickets": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/WrittenTicket"}, "title": "Tickets", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["tickets"], "title": "ticket_texts", "type": "object"}

value.text: {"tickets": [{"body": "Hi there, I am really confused about what is happening right now. Several patients are calling our front desk saying they cannot log into their online accounts or reset their passwords, and our staff are locked out of helping them unlock their profiles too. Is the whole system experiencing an outage today? We cannot work normally like this and need some help figuring out what broke.", "id": "gen-191", "subject": "Portal login failures and account locks"}, {"body": "We need to set up online booking for patients through the portal, but want to restrict it to routine visit types only. Please let us know how to limit this for specific providers. Thanks.", "id": "gen-192", "subject": "Online appointment booking restriction setup"}, {"body": "I am trying to figure out how our waiting room queue functions during busy clinic hours. Currently, the arrival times and rooming status columns are cluttered, and I need to know how to customize which columns appear on my screen. I tried looking in the settings menu next to the schedule view, but could not find a way to edit the layout. Please advise how to clean this up so I can track patient flow better.", "id": "gen-193", "subject": "Customize waiting room status columns"}, {"body": "Please advise how we can update the reminder language on our monthly patient billing statements. We need to send out the next batch soon and want to make sure the text is correct.", "id": "gen-194", "subject": "Update monthly statement reminder language"}, {"body": "Hello, I am reviewing our current security posture for our solo practice and need guidance on configuring advanced role-based access permissions. I want to ensure that any future billing staff or temporary helpers have strictly limited visibility into sensitive financial reports while keeping clinical charts accessible. Could you provide documentation or a step-by-step walkthrough for tailoring custom permission levels in our enterprise tier environment?", "id": "gen-195", "subject": "Configure custom security roles and permission levels"}, {"body": "I cannot figure out how to route abnormal lab results to my covering physician when I am out. This is driving me crazy, please fix or tell me where the button is.", "id": "gen-196", "subject": "Routing abnormal labs to covering physician"}, {"body": "Please provide instructions on how to properly attach scanned paper reports and outside imaging files to patient charts without encountering upload errors.", "id": "gen-197", "subject": "Attaching external paper lab reports to charts"}, {"body": "Hello, I am so sorry to bother support with this, but I am struggling with an electronic lab order for a patient. I tried clearing my browser cache and re-entering the diagnosis code, but it still fails. Could you please help me figure out what is causing this rejection so I can get it sent over?", "id": "gen-198", "subject": "Fix rejected electronic lab requisition order"}, {"body": "We keep getting validation errors when trying to batch our insurance claims for electronic submission. Please tell me how to fix this mess right now.", "id": "gen-200", "subject": "Misapplied payments across multiple invoice lines"}]}
